body.message:
I do not accept this claim, and I also do not accept any deduction from my security deposit.

I stayed in this apartment for more than six months and never noticed any signs of bed bugs. As you know, I was even planning to extend my stay, but you informed me that the apartment was already booked.

Please provide evidence that proves I was responsible for introducing bed bugs into the apartment. Until you provide clear and convincing evidence, I do not agree to any deduction from my security deposit.
